lines.text: Cold air settles around you. Behind you is a heavy wooden door. A narrow stone passage continues north.
Water ticks steadily onto stone. The passage runs south to north. Somewhere to the east, you hear a faint draft.
You step into a shallow alcove. Your footsteps sound close here. The stone wall is inches from your hands. The passage lies west.
The corridor opens into a round chamber. Your footsteps carry farther now. Water echoes from a deep well in the center. The passage back is south.
